issuer: the traffic authority of each emirate (the Ministry of Interior's traffic departments; Abu Dhabi's through TAMM; Dubai's Roads and Transport Authority)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on u.ae, the UAE government's official portal (Get a driving licence, updated 28 October 2026). The minimum age for cars and light vehicles is 18 (17 for motorcycles); citizens and expatriate residents get a licence after classes at a registered institute and the local traffic authority's tests, from the traffic authority of the emirate where they opened a traffic file. A new licence is valid one year for those under 21 and two years for those 21 or older; renewed, ten years for UAE and GCC citizens, five for expatriate residents over 21 and one for those under 21. The term turns on the holder's age and nationality, which the form can't hold, so it is null. Each emirate's authority charges its own fees, none read, so the fee is null; the emirates aren't kept one by one. The licences exchanged (the 'Markhoos' initiative and the exchange list) weren't read. The identity card is the ids engine's (Emirates ID).

sources.said: minimum age requirement to obtain a driving licence is as follows: ... 18 years for cars and light vehicles ... passing the tests conducted by local transport authorities. A new driving licence is valid for 1 year for those under 21, and for 2 years for those who are 21 or older. ... To learn driving, you need to open a traffic file with the respective local traffic authority. ... obtaining the driving licence from the traffic authority. ... 10 years for all UAE and GCC citizens
